name: Postpartum Haemorrhage: Atony, Trauma, Tissue and Thrombin

reference.source: Sakshi Arora Obstetrics E9 + Gynecology by Ten Teachers 21st Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Overdistended myometrium fatigues failing retraction leaving sinuses open while retained cotyledons block contraction; fibrinogen consumes bleeding diluting further, and tranexamic plasmin blockade stabilises fresh clot within golden hours.
